title: freeze.v1 — the gate-authored half (F02 lane contract §5.2; blueprint 03 §4.1)
description: STAMPED, in full. No proposer-emittable form of this object exists: it is never constructed from user/model input, only stamped by the lld-ready gate (F06, fleet). Every property here is gate output, not proposer content -- contrast module-brief.v1.json, which is entirely proposer content and entirely non-authoritative. Named divergences from blueprint 03 §4.1, each individually justified in the F02 lane contract: freeze_id is patterned (03's `id` is not, and collides with sow.rs's own `id`); content_hash is prefixed `sha256:` (03's bare hex pattern already produced one wrong alg/digest mapping, F02 §4.4); killed_alternatives carries the missing minItems:2 floor (F02 §4.2); supersedes is required-and-nullable, not optional (a tightening); stamped_by is `keel:lld-ready`, not `orb:lld-ready` (F02 §4.1 -- the gate is fleet's, so the const naming "only the gate can satisfy this" must not name the proposer).

acceptsWhen.description: 03 §4.1's `accepts_when` -- reverts the orb's `acceptance_test` name back to the blueprint's. 03 §6 maps accepts_when.{predicate,artifact} by name into the blind-suite seed (F07 reads it) -- the field name is load-bearing, not cosmetic.

depthEvidence.description: 03 §4.1's name ("the R17-R21 block the gate validated"). REPORTED, NEVER THE PASS CRITERION -- a gate never treats depth_evidence.score.ratio as a threshold (see LldReadyGate.ts). The only place a JSON number lives in this whole contract; this is why the freeze itself is never hashed (F02 §6.3).

node_id.description: AUTHORED (copied). Must equal the enclosing module_brief.node_id -- cross-field, checked by the lld.v1 wrapper validator, not by this file alone.

content_hash.description: STAMPED. sha256(canonical_json(module_brief)), hex, prefixed with the algorithm name (F02 §4.4 -- the estate runs two 256-bit hex hashes; an unlabelled pattern already produced one wrong alg/digest mapping in blueprint 03 §6).

killed_alternatives.description: STAMPED. Blueprint 03 §4.1's `rejected`, renamed to FEATURES.md's own wording, with the missing R21 floor restored (F02 §4.2 -- this floor did not exist anywhere before F02, not in the schema and not in either mirror).

supersedes.description: STAMPED. Required-and-nullable (03 §4.1 has it merely optional) -- a tightening: null for v1, the prior freeze_id otherwise. You cannot forget to consider it.

stamped_by.description: STAMPED. The one field a proposer would love to forge, pinned to a const only the gate can satisfy -- there is no proposer path that writes this string (F02 §4.1). kills (structural) a hand-authored freeze.
